goals.name: ICP Research Goal Harness
goals.description: ICP Research Goal Harness [gtm-icp-research] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hD-02-icp-research.yaml
goals.gate: ICP doc shipped at artifacts/icp/<run>/icp.md with evidence anchors, anti-ICP, and kill criteria

gates.name: 0.1 Research question declared before any scraping: which segmen
gates.description: Research question declared before any scraping: which segment, which hypothesis, which decision this ICP feeds
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/question.md contains segment, hypothesis, decision fields (all non-empty)

gates.name: 0.2 rig-crm and data-sourcing doctrine loaded; Twenty CRM reacha
gates.description: rig-crm and data-sourcing doctrine loaded; Twenty CRM reachable

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated (L1-L3, D1-D2, A1-A2)
gates.command: coordinate block in ~/.hermes/jake/icp/session-<ts>.log parseable by jq

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_icp declared with all 7 components
gates.description: Harness tuple H_icp declared with all 7 components

gates.name: 1.1 Source inventory enumerated before analysis: CRM segment que
gates.description: Source inventory enumerated before analysis: CRM segment query, closed-won/closed-lost exports, external enrichment provider, review sites (G2/Capterra)
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/sources.json lists >= 3 origins each with url_or_query, fetched_at, row_count, license_or_tos_note

gates.name: 1.2 Sample size floor met: >= 30 accounts in the analyzed cohort
gates.description: Sample size floor met: >= 30 accounts in the analyzed cohort or an explicit small-sample caveat recorded
gates.command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('artifacts/icp/<run>/cohort.json')); assert len(d['accounts']) >= 30 or d.get('small_sample_caveat')" exit 0

gates.name: 1.3 Closed-lost and churned accounts included — ICP built only f
gates.description: Closed-lost and churned accounts included — ICP built only from winners is rejected
gates.command: cohort.json outcome field contains both 'won' and 'lost' values; jq '[.accounts[].outcome] | unique | length >= 2' true

gates.name: 2.1 Firmographic extraction scripted, not hand-assembled: indust
gates.description: Firmographic extraction scripted, not hand-assembled: industry, size band, geography, tech stack signals per account
gates.command: python3 scripts/extract_firmographics.py --cohort artifacts/icp/<run>/cohort.json --out firmographics.csv exit 0; csv has >= 4 attribute columns

gates.name: 2.2 Buying-trigger signals identified from win/loss notes or cal
gates.description: Buying-trigger signals identified from win/loss notes or call transcripts with quote anchors
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/triggers.jsonl — each trigger has >= 2 verbatim quote anchors with source record ids

gates.name: 2.3 Anti-ICP defined explicitly: segments to exclude with the da
gates.description: Anti-ICP defined explicitly: segments to exclude with the data reason for each exclusion
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/anti_icp.md lists >= 2 exclusions each with supporting metric (win_rate, churn_rate, or sales_cycle_days)

gates.name: 2.4 Attribute-to-outcome correlation computed: which attributes
gates.description: Attribute-to-outcome correlation computed: which attributes actually separate won from lost
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/correlation_report.md contains per-attribute win-rate deltas computed by scripts/icp_correlation.py; every claimed attribute shows its delta number

gates.name: 3.1 Every load-bearing claim in the ICP doc carries an evidence
gates.description: Every load-bearing claim in the ICP doc carries an evidence anchor (CRM query id, file path + line, or source URL)
gates.command: grep -cE '\[evidence:' artifacts/icp/<run>/icp.md >= number of ## claim headers; zero unanchored claims

gates.name: 3.2 ICP falsifiability statement: the doc names what future data
gates.description: ICP falsifiability statement: the doc names what future data would prove it wrong
gates.command: icp.md contains a '## Kill Criteria' section with >= 2 measurable conditions

gates.name: 3.3 CRM segment validation: the ICP definition runs as a Twenty
gates.description: CRM segment validation: the ICP definition runs as a Twenty query and returns a plausible nonzero count
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/segment_query.json executed; result count recorded in validation.log; count > 0 and count < total_people

gates.name: 3.4 Independent review dispatch: a second pass (agent or human)
gates.description: Independent review dispatch: a second pass (agent or human) attempts to refute the top 3 ICP attributes
gates.command: artifacts/icp/<run>/refute_pass.md with verdict per attribute (confirmed | weakened | rejected) and reasoning

preconditions.startup_phrase: ICP research session. The ICP is a falsifiable artifact, not a vibe. Every attribute is anchored to data.
preconditions.harness_tuple: H_icp(question, sources, sample, firmographics, anti_icp, evidence, validation)
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for data extraction and validation; A2 for pattern synthesis; A3 only for hypothesis framing; A4 never

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times; an ICP kill criterion firing in production triggers immediate harness review

success_conditions: ICP doc shipped at artifacts/icp/<run>/icp.md with evidence anchors, anti-ICP, and kill criteria
Cohort, firmographics, correlation report, and segment validation all present and hashed in proofpacket.json
Closed-lost data represented; no winners-only ICP accepted
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict (validated | provisional | refuted), next safe action in session log
failure_states: halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 2.2, 2.4, 3.3, 3.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Research question declared before any scraping: which segment, which hypothesis, which decision this ICP feeds
rig-crm and data-sourcing doctrine loaded; Twenty CRM reachable
Harness tuple H_icp declared with all 7 components
Source inventory enumerated before analysis: CRM segment query, closed-won/closed-lost exports, external enrichment provider, review sites (G2/Capterra)
Sample size floor met: >= 30 accounts in the analyzed cohort or an explicit small-sample caveat recorded
Closed-lost and churned accounts included — ICP built only from winners is rejected
Firmographic extraction scripted, not hand-assembled: industry, size band, geography, tech stack signals per account
Buying-trigger signals identified from win/loss notes or call transcripts with quote anchors
Anti-ICP defined explicitly: segments to exclude with the data reason for each exclusion
Attribute-to-outcome correlation computed: which attributes actually separate won from lost
Every load-bearing claim in the ICP doc carries an evidence anchor (CRM query id, file path + line, or source URL)
ICP falsifiability statement: the doc names what future data would prove it wrong
CRM segment validation: the ICP definition runs as a Twenty query and returns a plausible nonzero count
Independent review dispatch: a second pass (agent or human) attempts to refute the top 3 ICP attributes

final_rule: No ICP attribute ships without an evidence anchor and a win/loss delta.
A winners-only ICP is a failed session, not a positive result.
An ICP without kill criteria is a horoscope, not a target.
Every ICP research session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
